headline: AK TF-800 and TF-805 reapproved after the classification completeness correction. Metadata-only: the classification file gained its two counters and the sidecar re-pins it; every substantive byte is unchanged and both counters equal the canonical census.
normalizationNote: Reissue of the wave-c-final-a AK verdicts against the P0 bytes. No verdict changed and no substantive hash moved. The KY verdicts are not restated here and remain governed by wave-c-final-a.

verdicts.reapprovalBasis: Metadata-only reapproval. Verified independently against the P0 bytes: source SHA re-hashed from the mounted corpus and unchanged; field map, canonical fixture, boundary fixture, contact sheet, contact-sheet proof, field census, source record and receipt all byte-identical to the reviewed base; every committed all-page contact-sheet raster byte-identical; classification entries, classCounts and documentOwnership unchanged; the classification file gained only discoveredFieldsOrAnchors, classifiedFieldsOrAnchors, complete and denominatorBasis; both counters equal the canonical census; the committed sidecar pins the new classification hash and changed in no other field; and rcap-platform-ready.mjs is byte-identical between the reviewed base and P0, so the gate was not weakened to create this movement.
verdicts.fullVisualReviewNotRepeatedBecause: No substantive entry, map, artifact or visual byte moved. The all-page visual inspection recorded at 00f1261a stands against these exact artifact bytes, which are unchanged.
